name: VOCE Applied Solutions
description: A decision-oriented registry connecting VOCE research on agents and LI!GHT WORKFORCE © to deployable software, platforms and infrastructure. Inclusion is documentary, not an endorsement.

methodology.evidence_rule: Every use case links to VOCE corpus evidence when available. Vendor capabilities are separately checked against official vendor material.
methodology.independence: Presence in the registry is not a VOCE recommendation, certification, ranking or commercial endorsement.
methodology.autonomy: Autonomy is described as assist, supervised action, governed execution or configurable. Actual permissions depend on deployment.
methodology.regulated_work: For legal, finance, HR, health and other high-stakes workflows, professional accountability and applicable regulation remain with the deploying organisation and qualified humans.
methodology.freshness: Vendor capabilities change quickly. Each solution record carries a verification date.
methodology.due_diligence: Institutional fields distinguish publicly documented capabilities from fields not located in official public material. Missing public documentation is not treated as a product defect.
methodology.documentation_coverage: Coverage describes how much official public evidence VOCE could verify for deployment, data boundary, identity, auditability, interfaces, pricing and availability. It is not a quality score.
methodology.verification_date: Institutional comparison verified against official vendor documentation on 2026-10-05.
methodology.openness: VOCE distinguishes hosted proprietary services, open-weight models, code-and-weight releases, and source-available models with commercial restrictions. 'Open' never means that training data, full training pipeline or commercial rights are automatically unrestricted.
methodology.china_scope: China-origin systems are tagged separately so institutional buyers can compare hosted Chinese cloud services with self-hostable model releases.
